intro: The Forgotten Pool is a submerged cavern tucked deep beneath the flooded corridors of Blackfathom Deeps. Located beyond the Moonshrine Ruins, this quiet dead-end serves as the aquatic lair of monstrous deep-sea predators lurking in the subterranean dark.

p: Reaching the Forgotten Pool requires diving into the sunken subterranean waterways extending past the Moonshrine Ruins. Cut off from dry ground, the pool is an isolated, stagnant cavern completely flooded by dark waters. Away from the chanting Twilight's Hammer cultists and the patrolling naga, this secluded pocket serves as the lair of the ancient aquatic terror known as Old Serra'kis, keeping the beast hidden in the flooded dark.
